trova: By 14:40 the toes are numb. Dr. Bashir learns from the operating room desk that Dr. Kirby is scrubbed in a case expected to finish around 16:30, and through the house supervisor he reaches the chief of surgery, Dr. Helen Eastman, who is at the bedside at 15:25. Dr. Kirby never comes; his only answer is a call from the operating room at 16:35, when Mrs. Ainsworth is in the angiography suite and the decision has been made without him. Nobody need have failed for that to happen, and that is what makes the note hard to write.
